about: OwnershipStateMachine with the default policy, replayed call by call. Positions are 1/512 m grid units and velocities float32 bits. Each outcome is the result, reclaim reason, state, owner slot (0 is the server), epoch and whether it changed, then the machine's distance credit, its cooldowns as [participant, until, length of the last strike] in participant order, and whether a first sample is still owed. A grab, steal or catch needs the requester's avatar within the hold range of the body; a throw needs the body's last validated position within it of the holder; a grant with no sample by its deadline, a silent owner and a missing hand-back are reclaimed and make that participant yield, and so does a hand-back before the first sample. A request from another participant within the hold range, denied while the body is held, contests the hold; the owner of a contested hold yields once it hands back or fails validation. A closed link reclaims the participant's hold: it yields if the hold had no first sample or was contested, and the hold is otherwise remembered as a release. Every participant has its own cooldown. Going quiet, failing validation, and letting go (a hand-back or a closed link) before the first sample or before the hold has lasted half the 1 s release window are strikes; a strike within 8 s after the participant's last cooldown ended costs twice its last strike, at most 8 s, and any other strike 1 s. Any other yield is taking turns and costs 1 s, leaving the last strike as it was. Every grant, a steal included, starts an uncontested hold. An uncontested hold that ends by a hand-back, a failed validation or a closed link is remembered with its time, and whether yielding for it would be a strike, until the body is granted or reclaimed; a request naming another epoch while the body is free, from another participant within the hold range, within 1 s after that release, makes the releaser yield from then, once. A disconnect forgets the participant's cooldown and release. The last four outcome fields are whether the current hold is contested, the remembered releaser (0 for none), its release time and whether yielding for that release would be a strike.
